nodes.name: Electrodeposition of Co(OH)2
nodes.procedure: In a typical procedure, a piece of blank CC electrode (0.5 cm x 2 cm) was washed ultrasonically in ultrapure water and alcohol, respectively. Then, the electrodeposition of Co(OH)2 nanosheets was conducted with a conventional three-electrode setup... performed 10 CV cycles between 0 and -1.4 V versus Ag/AgCl in an aqueous solution of 0.05 M Co(NO3)2. The scan rate was 50 mV s-1. After the electrodeposition, the Co(OH)2 nanosheets were carefully rinsed with ultrapure water and dried in air.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of NiPx on Co(OH)2
nodes.procedure: The Co(OH)2 nanosheets were adopted as the substrate for the nucleation and growth of NiPx... The aqueous electrolyte consisted of 0.1 M CH3COONa, 0.05 M Ni(CH3COO)2, 0.1 M NaH2PO2. NiPx would be successfully anchored on the Co(OH)2 nanosheets after 5 CV cycles between 0 and -1 V versus Ag/AgCl at a scan rate of 50 mV s-1, resulting in Co(OH)2/NiPx nanosheets with abundant heterostructures.

nodes.description: OER performance of optimal Co(OH)2/NiPx (5 cycles) in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: The optimal heterostructured Co(OH)2/ NiPx nanosheets need an overpotential of only 236 mV to reach the current density of 10 mA cm−2, and the Tafel slope is 52 mV dec−1... deliver large current densities of 100 and 400 mA cm−2 at the overpotential of 304 and 340 mV, respectively... the Cdl of Co(OH)2/NiPx with 5 CV cycles (0.181 mF) was ≈3.3 times larger than Co(OH)2... After 40 000 s electrolysis, about 17 mV potential drop could be obviously observed... contact angle of Co(OH)2/NiPx was as low as 18.9°. After the ECSA normalization, the Co(OH)2/NiPx displayed the highest intrinsic OER performance.
